response: In the heart of the neighborhood, the tradition of folding paper lanterns has been passed down through generations. Each lantern is a delicate masterpiece, crafted with care and precision. As the sun sets, the community gathers to fold and assemble these beautiful lanterns, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The process is not only a craft but also a way to bring people together, fostering a sense of unity and pride. With each fold, the lanterns take shape, symbolizing hope and celebration. The neighbors share tips and techniques, passing down knowledge from one generation to the next. The lanterns are then placed on the porch or in the park, lighting up the night with a soft, golden glow. This annual event brings a sense of joy and nostalgia, reminding everyone of the beauty of community. The lanterns serve as a reminder of the importance of tradition and the power of collective effort. As the night unfolds, the lanterns illuminate the streets, creating a magical and peaceful ambiance. P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
